tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List a bounded page of Tutorializer projects the authenticated user has access to. Returns a Markdown table of id, name, domain, and last edit time.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch a single Tutorializer project by immutable id or stable public vanity id. Returns the project metadata, its locale and voice settings, and any pronunciation rules formatted as Markdown.

tools.name: get_project_localization_summary
tools.description: Audit one Tutorializer project across configured locales, rendered-video locales/devices, and speech languages. Reads at most 100 rows per content type and marks truncated totals as lower bounds.

tools.name: list_tutorials
tools.description: List Tutorializer tutorial definitions. Optionally filter by projectId. Returns a Markdown table of id, name, project, default voice, and last edit time; rendered locales and devices live on videos.

tools.name: get_tutorial
tools.description: Fetch one Tutorializer tutorial definition and a bounded preview of its rendered locale/device outputs. A tutorial does not itself have a locale or status; those vary per video.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List rendered Tutorializer videos. Optionally filter by projectId, tutorialId, locale, and device. Returns a Markdown table of output dimensions, locale, device, format, and URL.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Fetch a single rendered Tutorializer video by id. Returns its tutorial, locale, device, dimensions, primary media URL, chapters, subtitles, and thumbnail metadata.

tools.name: list_speeches
tools.description: List a bounded page of Tutorializer speeches (voiceover segments). Optionally filter by projectId and language. Returns a safe preview of id, text, language, project, and URL.

tools.name: get_speech
tools.description: Fetch a single Tutorializer speech (voiceover segment) by id. Returns the speech metadata plus its full source text and translation formatted as Markdown.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a Tutorializer project. State-changing and non-idempotent: repeating the call creates another project, so list projects and confirm the intended name first.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Change a Tutorializer project’s name, domain, locales, default voice or narration speed. Reads the stored project first and rewrites the whole record, so unspecified fields keep their current values. The locales list is a complete replacement, and removing a locale stops it being expected by the loc

tools.name: create_tutorial
tools.description: Create a Tutorializer tutorial definition inside a project. State-changing and non-idempotent: repeating the call creates another tutorial, so list tutorials and confirm the intended name first. This records the tutorial; it does not record or render a video.

tools.name: update_tutorial
tools.description: Rename a Tutorializer tutorial or change the default voice used for its narration. Reads the stored tutorial first and rewrites the whole record, so unspecified fields keep their current values. Submitting the values it already has is a no-op.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Register one already-uploaded rendered tutorial video with Tutorializer, recording its locale, device, dimensions and media URLs. State-changing and non-idempotent: repeating the call registers a second output. This does not record, render or upload a file; host the file first and pass its public ht

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Correct the metadata of one registered Tutorializer rendered video, such as its locale, device, dimensions or media URLs. Reads the stored record first and rewrites the whole document, so unspecified fields keep their current values. Submitting the values it already has is a no-op.

tools.name: create_speech
tools.description: Create one Tutorializer voiceover segment for a project. Without a url it synthesizes narration audio from the text with the project's speech provider, which consumes the organization's synthesis credits and is billable. Pass url instead to register audio you already produced. State-changing and non

tools.name: update_speech
tools.description: Change the text, translation, language or voice of one Tutorializer voiceover segment. Every one of those fields determines the audio, so a real change re-synthesizes the segment with the project's speech provider, consumes synthesis credits and replaces the previous audio. Submitting the values it

tools.name: set_pronunciation_rule
tools.description: Add or replace one project pronunciation rule and synchronize its ElevenLabs pronunciation dictionary. Repeating an identical rule is a no-op.

tools.name: remove_pronunciation_rule
tools.description: Remove one project pronunciation rule and synchronize its ElevenLabs dictionary. Destructive but idempotent: a missing rule is a no-op. Existing speech audio is not regenerated automatically.

tools.name: delete_tutorial
tools.description: Permanently delete one Tutorializer tutorial definition. Idempotent, but the definition must be authored again to restore it. Rendered videos and voiceover segments are not deleted with it; remove those separately.

tools.name: delete_speech
tools.description: Permanently delete one Tutorializer speech record plus its S3 audio and alignment files. Idempotent, but deleted audio cannot be recovered without synthesizing it again and spending credits.

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Permanently delete one Tutorializer rendered-video record and its primary S3 object. Idempotent, but the render must be uploaded or generated again to restore it.

tools.name: show_project_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded tenant-scoped Tutorializer project snapshot with tutorial, video, and voiceover counts. Use this after listing projects or when the user provides an immutable project id or stable public vanity id.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_videos, get_video, list_speeches · Private data: update_project, create_tutorial, update_tutorial, create_video, update_video, delete_speech, delete_video · Public sink: create_video · Destructive: list_videos, remove_pronunciation_rule, delete_tutorial, delete_speech, delete_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_videos, get_video, list_speeches · Private data: update_project, create_tutorial, update_tutorial, create_video, update_video, delete_speech, delete_video · Public sink: create_video · Destructive: list_videos, remove_pronunciation_rule, delete_tutorial, delete_speech, delete_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
